CanBeGeneratedInCombat.rationale: `=> false` (Soot.cs:8) == the class attribute -- correctly mapped, unlike the three Knowledge-Demon statuses, which set `can_be_generated_by_modifiers` instead. Worth naming because Soot is a Status like they are, so the sim clearly knows the right mapping.

CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Unplayable }` (Soot.cs:12) == `is_playable = False`. No Ethereal and no Exhaust, so Soot sits in hand for the rest of the turn -- the dead-draw shape.

ctor.issue: STATUS / STATUS / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1`, and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses, statuses or quests.

OnPlay.rationale: Soot.cs has no members beyond the three overrides -- no OnPlay, no OnTurnEndInHand, no vars. A pure dead draw on both sides.

guards.what: the sim adds `is_unpowered = True` (soot.py:221), which has no counterpart in Soot.cs
guards.rationale: Inert: the flag only steers `DamageCmd.deal`'s prop inference and Soot deals no damage.
